tabby:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D game sprite sheet, eight-frame looping walk animation for a tiny desktop mascot in a terminal title bar.
Primary request: an adorable anime chibi orange tabby kitten walking toward the RIGHT, in clean hand-drawn Japanese animation style. Oversized rounded head, bright blue eye in side profile, tiny pink nose and inner ears, cream muzzle and belly, three clear darker ginger stripes, soft fluffy cheek tufts, short rounded paws, a curved upright tail. Bold dark warm-brown outline, flat cel shading, simple readable shapes that remain legible when reduced to 32 pixels high. Animal kitten on four legs, no clothing or props.
Layout: EXACTLY eight complete full-body sprites in an invisible regular grid of FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, read left to right on the top row then left to right on the bottom row. One kitten per cell, equal scale and consistent proportions throughout. Every cat faces strictly RIGHT in profile; tail to the left, face to the right. The entire tail, ears and paws fit inside each cell with generous clear margins. All grounded paws share the same baseline within each cell. Keep the head and torso aligned in every cell with only a slight natural walk bounce.
Motion: eight successive distinct evenly spaced phases of one smooth relaxed quadruped walk cycle. Alternate front and rear paws through contact, down, passing, and up positions, then the opposite stride. Clearly change leg positions between frames; gently sway tail. Frame eight loops seamlessly to frame one. This is one consistent kitten animated eight times, not eight character designs. No horizontal translation inside cells.
Backdrop: a completely flat uniform vivid chroma green (#00FF00) background, including all margins and all space between paws and tail. No green anywhere on the kitten. No ground, shadows, gradients, scenery, props, sparkles, transparency checkerboard, panels, grid lines, text, frame numbers, signatures or watermarks.
